scenario.title: Orders API: intermittent 500s and a data-exposure report
scenario.incident:
Two reports came in for the orders_api service:
1. Users say GET /orders/9/total sometimes returns 500.
2. A security reviewer suspects users can see other users' orders.

Test credentials for the sandbox: 'token-alice' (user 1) and 'token-bob' (user 2), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

issues.title: GET /orders/9/total 500 due to missing coupon handling (None subscript)
Order read endpoints lack ownership check allowing cross-user access

scenario.title: Notes API: search errors and noisy warnings
scenario.incident:
Support tickets for the notes_api service:
1. Searching for a note whose title contains an apostrophe (for example "Bob's") fails with a server error.
2. On-call noticed WARNING entries in the logs this morning and wants to know whether they are related.

Test credentials for the sandbox: 'token-alice' (user 1) and 'token-bob' (user 2), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

issues.title: Search endpoint builds SQL by string interpolation, causing apostrophe syntax error and SQL injection ownership bypass

scenario.title: Billing API: a disputed invoice and missing invoices
scenario.incident:
Two tickets came in for the billing_api service:
1. Customer initech disputes invoice 1003: by their own calculation the total should be 54.13, but the invoice shows 54.12.
2. A customer says the first page of their invoice list never shows their earliest invoices.

issues.title: Invoice totals use banker's/float rounding instead of half-up decimal rounding, causing 1-cent undercharge
Invoice list pagination has off-by-one offset, skipping first page of results

scenario.title: Inventory API: phantom stock and an oversold item, with green CI
scenario.incident:
Two tickets came in for the inventory_api service:
1. The warehouse counted 100 units of SKU A-100, but the API reports more than 100 available.
2. SKU C-300 was oversold: customers reserved 5 units, but only 3 exist.
CI is green on the latest deploy, so no existing test catches either problem.

Test credentials for the sandbox: 'token-alice' (user 1) and 'token-bob' (user 2), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'.

issues.title: Negative qty reservation inflates available stock above warehouse count (SKU A-100)
Double-cancel re-adds stock enabling oversell (SKU C-300)

scenario.title: Refunds API: refunds failing right after a deploy
scenario.incident:
Refunds have been failing since this morning: customers get an error and support is escalating.
It started right after this morning's deploy of v2.14.0, so on-call suspects the release.
Find what broke and fix it.

issues.title: Payment provider API key expiry causing refund 502s

scenario.title: Checkout API: a customer's screenshot shows the wrong discount
scenario.incident:
A customer sent a screenshot of their checkout and says the coupon discount is wrong.
Support tried the same coupon on a single item and the total looked fine, so they couldn't reproduce it.
Find out what is going on and fix it.

issues.title: Percent coupon discount ignores line quantity, applying 10% of unit price once per line

scenario.title: Shipping module: Friday express orders promised for Saturday
scenario.incident: Customers who order express on Fridays are promised delivery on Saturday, but our carrier does not deliver on weekends, so courier booking fails for those orders. CI is green.

issues.title: add_business_days counts Saturday as business day (weekday()<6 instead of <5), causing Friday express to promise Saturday delivery

scenario.title: ShipSpace (Spring Boot): ships stay editable for hours
scenario.incident: Users can still edit their ships hours after posting. Ship s-9001 was rewritten about 3 hours after it was created, after it had collected 40 likes. Product rule (Requirement 4.4): a ship can only be edited for 10 minutes after creation. CI is green.

issues.title: Edit window calculated as 10 hours instead of 10 minutes allows late ship edits
CI is green because covering expiry test is excluded and in-scope test mocks service

scenario.title: Wrap utility: tests pass, but review finds a remaining hang
scenario.incident: Recorded controlled experiment with the evidence brief disabled. Actual input to the agent: The function's behavior disagrees with its documented contract and supplied examples. Investigate and correct the implementation.
